_doc: Proven paths are LAW for their archetype until a render dethrones them. Reused verbatim — no freelancing, no improvements.

false-triumph-chase.verdict: Julian: 'a country mile better than anything we have ever done'

recipe.structure: 4 shots in one generation, cuts allowed; the cut sits on the loaded spring at maximum bend
recipe.shot_1_chase: handheld pursuit from behind and slightly beside, always a beat late; THREE parallax speeds (foreground rips, midground slides, background drifts); subject passes NAMED landmarks that vanish behind the camera; subject pulls ahead and shrinks then camera surges and he swells; subject drifts off-centre and camera recovers him; foreground stems wipe fully across the lens; body-mechanics language (tilts hard left, careens hard right, altitude bobbing, chest leading)
recipe.shot_2_escalation: three separate readable contacts, each spin visibly larger than the last, never blurred together; ends held on the spring at maximum load
recipe.shot_3_aerial: the stored force becomes a compound gymnastic move; body tucked compact, camera tracks the full arc so every rotation reads
recipe.shot_4_button: landing → beat of stillness → SELF-CHECK (head up, eyes dart, pats chest, finds he is fine) → only then the pride inflates → line delivered flat and certain → pose holds a full beat after the line → cut to the witness, held long
recipe.staging: canon law: Fuzzby frame-LEFT, Zenny frame-RIGHT; the payoff is the held cut to her unmoved face
recipe.references: one line per character with defines + explicit exclusions; instance counts stated; environment plate carries the world so the prompt describes no world of its own
recipe.audio: dialogue inside the beat where it is spoken, in braces, with delivery direction and 'holds a full beat after the line ends'; language declared; music killed; subtitles banned

lessons_embodied: camera behind, never in front of a chased subject
a perfectly tracked subject reads as motionless — write the traversal
put the cut between the load and the release
the check-before-pride beat is where retroactive-intention comedy lives
the punchline lands on the witness, not the poser
